**sdd/issue-576-archetypes/proposal**

Full file: openspec/changes/issue-576-archetypes/proposal.md (worktree /home/gandalf/IA/brain-issue-576, off main@4cde50e). M5 step B — closes M5 and #754.

Decisions (maintainer, 02/09/2026):
- D1: projection targets = claude (.claude/agents/*.md) + antigravity (AGENTS.md section via compileAgentsMd's pipeline). SDD_ENGINE frameworks DECLARE, never receive projection (D6).
- D2: ADR-0023 drafted HERE from what exists (port n=2, instructions, first-party, taxonomy) → brain-drafts/, promoted by the maintainer via brain:promote within the PR (Ruta A — #312's plan executed one milestone late, said openly).
- D3: jd-* LEFT with a double reason: (a) they are gentle-ai framework content installed on one machine — brain inherits nothing from installed files without an agnostic contract, #814's own rule; exposure path is declareRoles; (b) authority collision with brain's reviewer/verify — two parallel Adversaries compete with the cold review. Adoption imports a conflict, not a capability. [Maintainer's own words: "los jueces chocan con el reviewer de brain o con la etapa de verify".]
- D4: resolve-challenger.mjs binding half retires here (header's own instruction); AXIS resolution kept.

Scope: archetype layer on first-party/ (ONLY the three new fields: archetype, escalation, output_contract — each labelled mechanical|doctrinal per #499; writes/reads stay the port's); the reviewer instance (Verifier) from reviewer-protocol.md §2; projectRole(role, platform) byte-deterministic + drift guards; lock survival proven post-move; ADR-0023 draft; challenger as port caller.
Non-goals: lifecycle routing (M8), jd-* adoption, a brain/core/roles tree with its own schema, mechanical blindness (doctrinal, L6/#584 precedent).
Risks: native formats drifting (guards ARE the deliverable), ADR promotion in-PR (decision-gate pair + label, maintainer ceremony on the branch), challenger rewire touches the verdict path (neutrality discipline).
